name: [🔥2.1 ] RE:Heads, Please!
desc:
Welcome to RE:Heads, Please!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🪙 Flip coins to earn money!
💲 Roll better coins!
👚 Roll cute & cool accessories!
🛹 Hop on a skateboard and explore the map!
🚇 Travel Another Station and Enjoy Sub Content!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Coin Flip: Click / Touch / RT
Skateboard Ride: Q / LT
Skateboard Boost: R / LB
Emote: G / D-Pad Down

❗ This game is still in beta, please report any bugs in-game! ❗
